name: Email deliverability monitor — alert before suppression

nodes.name: Schedule — Hourly Sweep
nodes.notes: Fires at the top of every hour. Drives the Postmaster, ESP, and DNSBL branches. Cron expression interpreted in workflow timezone (set in Settings).

nodes.name: Schedule — DMARC Poll
nodes.notes: Polls the DMARC RUA mailbox every 15 minutes for new aggregate reports.

nodes.name: Webhook — Ad-hoc Domain Check
nodes.notes: Manual check entrypoint. POST { "domain": "example.com" } to run the full sweep against a single domain on demand.

nodes.name: Respond 202 Accepted
nodes.notes: Return immediately so the caller is not blocked on the downstream polls.

nodes.name: Domain Register (Static)
nodes.notes: Edit the array to your real domains. severity drives alert color and routing.

nodes.name: Split In Batches
nodes.notes: Batches of 3 to keep Postmaster API and DNSBL probes under their per-second limits.

nodes.name: HTTP — Postmaster Tools
nodes.notes: Pulls trafficStats for the last 7 days. neverError so a 401/404 does not halt the batch.

nodes.name: HTTP — Smartlead Stats
nodes.notes: Reads Smartlead campaign-level complaint and bounce rates for the watched domain. Only runs when sendingPlatform === 'smartlead'.

nodes.name: HTTP — Instantly Health
nodes.notes: Reads Instantly account health for the domain. Only runs when sendingPlatform === 'instantly'.

nodes.name: DNSBL Probe (Code)
nodes.notes: Resolves MX → IP → queries each zone with reversed-octet form against 3 resolvers. status='critical' requires 2-of-3 resolver agreement.

nodes.name: Merge — Per-Domain Snapshot
nodes.notes: Normalizes Postmaster, Smartlead, Instantly, and DNSBL outputs into one record-per-(domain,metric,dateBucket). Rejects stale (>26h) and null-metric records.

nodes.name: Threshold Check (Code)
nodes.notes: All policy is in this node. Thresholds overridable via env. Postmaster downgrades critical→alert when fewer than POSTMASTER_MIN_POINTS_FOR_CRITICAL points exist.

nodes.name: Dedup Gate (Static Data)
nodes.notes: 12-hour dedup window per (domain, metric, status). Static data only persists on production runs.

nodes.name: Claude — Remediation Draft
nodes.notes: Haiku 4.5, 8s timeout, neverError. Returns a structured JSON remediation. Template fallback applied downstream.

nodes.name: Parse Remediation
nodes.notes: Claude-or-template fallback. draftSource tag exposed in Slack so reps know which they received.

nodes.name: Slack — Notify
nodes.notes: Routes to one of three channels by severity/status. Block Kit message with header, fields, remediation, and @-mention of the owner.

nodes.name: IMAP — DMARC Mailbox
nodes.notes: Reads unseen messages matching 'Report Domain' (the standard DMARC RUA subject pattern). Marks as seen after fetch.

nodes.name: Parse DMARC XML
nodes.notes: Unzips .gz/.zip attachments, parses DMARC XML, emits per-record rows. Flags spoofingSuspect when both SPF and DKIM evaluate to fail.

nodes.name: Merge — Inbound Branches
nodes.notes: Joins the hourly and DMARC branches into the shared threshold check.
